high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user `_space_pirate2.0`, located in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The post features a photograph of fossilized dinosaur eggs embedded in a rock. The text overlay on the image reads "Fossilized Dinosaur Eggs" in bright blue letters at the top. Below the image, there is a caption that states: "The above image shows fossilized dinosaur eggs found in India. These eggs can cost anywhere from 400 to a Million dollars." The photo itself shows a close-up of a rock with several spherical indentations, which appear to be the fossilized eggs.
